title: 第十三章  战斗
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“这就来了？”落到地上的叶落望着天上的巨鹰，“我滴乖乖，战斗力眼镜上显示是5466点战力，虽说对自己构不成威胁，但却也没有想到刚一下来就有聚灵境界的妖兽。

叶落没有什么犹豫，抬手，纳米金属粒子聚合，一张弓便出现在手上，拉开，灵力汇聚为箭，

“嗖！”

精准命中，那只巨鹰直接发出一声悲鸣，从天上直接掉落下血泊之中，

而叶落才刚刚把妖兽收进斗铠戒指里面，斗铠戒指基本上都是拥有一定的储物能力的。

突然，那边，迷雾中一阵急促风动，突破聚灵境，叶落也开始逐渐诞生灵识，警惕性自然非以前可比，他自然知道有学员来了。

不一会，两道人影已经分别自两个不同的方向冲了过来。

一个戴着老虎面具，而另外一个，则带着芭比娃娃的面具，看起来倒是颇为的.....嗯.......怎么说呢....嗯....诡异。

二人看到叶落，神经与肌肉一松，二人对视一眼，有一丝疑惑，

戴着芭比娃娃面具的那人问道：“刚刚我们看到有一道强大的灵力波动在这里亮起，有妖兽在这里被杀死了……在哪里？”，

听得那人的声音，叶落差点没鸡皮疙瘩起来，好令人恶心的声音啊。

“不知道，我也刚来。”

叶落沙哑着声音答道，初来秘境，他并不想树立多少敌人，更何况对方身上也一定和他一样有战力屏蔽仪，就算这样，瞧着这周身流转的灵力也不是善茬。

那二人目光先是在许灵钧身上上下打量，其后在四周环顾，没有看到妖兽血肉，问道：“你可有储物戒指？”

叶落有些不耐烦了，“怎么二位还想看我的戒指，我虽不想惹麻烦，但也不怕惹麻烦，你们是想试试我的身手吗？”

那两人互相戒备的看了对方一眼，

似乎看出了叶落也不是好惹的……

他们戒备的后退了两步，然后各自退去。

叶落轻轻松了口气，他其实不害怕战斗……

但这些人是他的同学。

如果他们真的满怀恶意的接近，他不介意教训他们一顿，但如果可以，他也并不想起无端的争执。

看到两人身影消失……

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Here it comes?" Ye Luo, who fell to the ground, looked at the giant eagle in the sky, "Hey, darling, the combat power glasses show 5466 combat power points. Although it does not pose a threat to myself, I did not expect that there would be a monster beast in the spirit-gathering realm right after it came out.

Ye Luo didn't hesitate. He raised his hand, the nanometal particles gathered together, and a bow appeared in his hand. He pulled it open, and his spiritual power gathered into an arrow.

“Whoosh!"

With a precise hit, the giant eagle let out a mournful cry and fell directly from the sky into a pool of blood.

And Ye Luo had just put the monster into the Doukai ring. Doukai rings basically have certain storage capabilities.

Suddenly, over there, there was a rapid gust of wind in the mist, breaking through the spirit-gathering realm. Ye Luo also began to gradually develop spiritual consciousness. His vigilance was naturally unmatched before. He naturally knew that a student was coming.

After a while, two figures rushed over from two different directions.

One is wearing a tiger mask, while the other is wearing a Barbie doll mask, which looks quite...well...how should I put it...well...weird.

When the two saw Ye Luo, their nerves and muscles relaxed. They looked at each other with a hint of doubt.

The man wearing the Barbie mask asked: "We just saw a powerful spiritual wave light up here, and a monster was killed here... Where is it?"",

Hearing that person's voice, Ye Luo almost got goosebumps. It was such a disgusting voice.

"I don't know, I just got here too."

Ye Luo replied in a hoarse voice. When he first came to the secret realm, he didn't want to make many enemies, not to mention that the opponent must have the same combat power shielding device as him. Even so, seeing the spiritual power flowing around him was not a good thing.

The two people first looked up and down Xu Lingjun, then looked around, but did not see the flesh and blood of the monster, and asked: "Do you have a storage ring?"

Ye Luo became a little impatient, "Why do you two still want to see my ring? Although I don't want to cause trouble, I'm not afraid of causing trouble. Do you want to try my skills?"

The two people looked at each other warily,

It seems that Ye Luo is not easy to mess with...

They took two steps back warily, and then retreated.

Ye Luo breathed a sigh of relief. He was actually not afraid of fighting...

But these people are his classmates.

If they really approached with malicious intent, he wouldn't mind giving them a lesson, but if possible, he wouldn't think of an unprovoked argument.

Seeing the two people disappear...
